Noel (Marketing): Heads up 1: CEO wants a small change to the lead quote in the benchmark blog. Hes asking to soften the performance claim. Need PR + ops sync before we push.
Priya (PR): What exactly changed? Can you paste the suggested quote?
Noel (Marketing): Current: "Our system reduces per-token latency by 40% versus baseline." CEO suggests: "We see materially lower per-token latency in many production workloads."
Alex (Comms): Thats a messaging shift from a hard comparative stat to a softer qualitative claim. Will update the quotables doc.
Sam (CEO): Quick context: Im worried the 40% number invites pushback from competitors and exacting reporters. Prefer the more defensible language.
Ivy (Legal): If we remove the explicit "40%" claim from the headline quote, we should still keep the technical appendix with the measured number and methodology. Adds transparency while keeping top-line safe.
Priya (PR): Agree. Plan: swap lead quote to CEOs phrasing, keep the 40% in the metrics section + add a short note about datasets and measurement window. PR will draft the updated press note.
Lena (Ops): Ops currently has the publish package staged for 14:00 PT. If we change the main copy, I need final markdown by 13:00 PT to re-run the render pipeline.
Noel (Marketing): OK action times: Priya update press note + quotable by 12:45, Alex update blog copy and send to Ops by 12:55, Lena to push staging render and run smoke checks, Ivy to sign off legal line.
publish-bot: scheduled_post.update  post_id=bench-2026-11; old_time=14:00 PT; new_time=14:00 PT at 1798888890
Priya (PR): Drafted press note and pasted below. Please review fast: 
---
Redwood Inference CEO Sam: "We see materially lower per-token latency in many production workloads, enabling teams to serve LLM features with less operational cost and better responsiveness."
---
Ivy (Legal): Add: "See technical appendix for measurement methodology and dataset details."
Alex (Comms): Updated the lead paragraph in the blog and pushed to the docs branch. Sending to Ops now.
Lena (Ops): Received. Running render now. If smoke checks pass, we can keep the 14:00 PT publish. If not, I'll notify immediately.
Noel (Marketing): Quick PR note: When we send to reporters, let's flag that the top quote was adjusted for clarity and that full metrics remain in the appendix. Keep wording simple.
Priya (PR): Will include that line in the reporter email. Also will inform embargoed outlets of the minor copy change; no need to revoke previews.
Sam (CEO): Thanks team. I prefer conservative topline messaging. Good to keep the data available for journalists who dig deeper.
Lena (Ops): Smoke checks green at 1798889155. Staging render matched production template.
publish-bot: notification  render_ok post_id=bench-2026-11 at 1798889156
Priya (PR): Sending updated assets to embargoed reporters now. Copy: "Minor change to lead quote for clarity; full metrics and methodology unchanged in appendix."
Noel (Marketing): Thanks all. Closing loop unless anyone sees an issue.
Alex (Comms): Noted, will update social snippets to match conservative quote.
Ivy (Legal): Signed off on the added methodology sentence.
Noel (Marketing): Great 1 closing thread.
